tr.headline: Written Briefing by Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong Regarding Mrs. Kim Hye-kyung’s Tea Party with the Association of Korean Women in Japan
tr.summary: This afternoon (the 10th), First Lady Kim Hye-kyung invited members of the Women’s Association of the Korean Residents’ Association in Japan (hereinafter “Mindan Women’s Association”) to the Blue House for a tea reception, where she expressed her gratitude and encouragement to the members who have long dedicated themselves to their homeland and the Korean community in Japan. Established in 1949 under the Korean Residents’ Association in Japan (Minjok), the Minjok Women’s Association is a women’s organization for Korean residents in Japan that is active throughout the country. Its activities include preserving the Korean language and traditional culture, nurturing the next generation of Korean residents, and promoting exchanges between Korean and Japanese women, among other initiatives…
